scopeNotice: Source inventory only; hashes bind the dirty working tree, not HEAD, deployment, D1 contents or installed APK. migrationFiles list historical SQL, not a live table count.

requirements.requirement: Durable history from every learning source and learner timeline
Adaptive competency path with substantively different session content
Audit and repair all learner/platform/authoring/native module links
Content provenance/review/authoring and measured learning/UX outcomes

lifecyclePolicies.L1: Capture ownerKey+ownerGeneration+resetEpoch before async work; keep source/version and first assistance; same retry identity, preserve pending on outage; reject stale scope; no authority promotion; same-key/different-payload conflict retained. Per-edge refinements below.
lifecyclePolicies.L2: Server-owned publication/RBAC/resource version, audited changes and immutable release; no learner progress writes. Replay/revoke/cache use exact revision; no deployment or external mutation in T00.

issues.finding: Current Header initials/Profile have no avatar lifecycle; no owner blob metadata/account media endpoint/native picker implementation.
No unified durable history contract/timeline/index across all sources; current activityLog/evidence/SQL analytics/Reader/workspace cover different subsets.
Client recovery exports projection and pending counts, not full journals/resumes/workspace/media; cloud owner export differs from device recovery.
Current adaptive/journey selects lessons and stages; no competency DAG/unit extractor/frozen adaptive manifest contract implemented.

Pilot draft has 9 activities and no attached audio across 3 lessons; humanReviewed false. Listening contrast/new held-out delayed probes and reviewed measurement content absent from pinned pilot inventory.
This turn does not verify current D1/hosted build/installed device. Prior fixture, build and release records remain scoped historical evidence.
Legacy backfill needs record lineage/cursor; unsupported/missing source-version or lost old-cutoff history remains unknown, never invented.
Existing dailyMinutes supports 10/20/30 only; 5-minute session budget and capabilities/opt-out need separate versioned preferences.

LearningJourneyStore uses guest resetEpoch 0 while durable stores carry reset epoch. Add guest reset with same anchor/old tab fixture before choosing adapter migration; no loss reproduction or fix claimed.
Pronunciation detailed acoustic report is component state; mission completion/reward evidence differs from durable per-attempt history. Audit exact receipt persistence and privacy in speech slice.

Expansion VocabularyMission stores index/revealed only in React. No durable progress/history/save/receipt producer; reload/resume and event adapters require a separate slice without claiming FSRS/mastery.
Pinned Git draft says draft-not-published and old review has source hashes; live published release head not read. Resolve exact revision before extracting units, never call latest draft released.
